document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
Sickened by what you saw, you flee into the heavy undergrowth 
and  keep  going  until  you  are  far,  far  away  from  the  cursed 
hollow. When your strength fails, you lie down and stare into 
the sky.

There can be only one explanation. Your experiences within 
this valley have been creations of your imagination. Perhaps you 
have breathed in some strange spore, or a natural hallucinogen 
has leached into the water supply. The thought brings you an 
odd peace, and you surrender to oblivion.
